Bench: Aravind Kumar

SUBHASH VITTHAL AHIRE Appellant(s)
VERSUS  THE STATE OF MAHARASHTRA & ANR.
Respondent(s  O R D E R Leave granted.
The appellant has been charged with offences punishable under Sections 376, 493, 494 and 496 of the Indian Penal Code.
The sum and substance of the allegation made in the complaint is that after the marriage, the complainant was abandoned by him without divorcing the first wife.

Learned senior counsel appearing for the appellant submits that the divorce petition was pending at the relevant point of time and the private respondent was aware of it despite which they were living together.
Even the private respondent has made a statement before the Departmental Enquiry stating there was no existing relationship with her and the appellant.
The present complaint has been given after Reason: a period of two years and seven months.
Considering that this is a civil dispute, a criminal colour is being given to it.
We have given sufficient opportunity to the respondent No.2 to appear before the Court.
On the last occasion, she did not appear and and even today she has not appeared.
Thus, we presume that she is not interested in appearing.
We find considerable force in the submission made by learned senior counsel appearing for the appellant.
